% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpTextfield[label=Single line,placeholder=Type some text...,clearable]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/textfield/textfield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-textfield");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Single line");
element1.setAttribute("placeholder", "Type some text...");
element1.setAttribute("clearable", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Inline named field
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Value: \wcTpTextfield*[name=identifier,value=Ada,placeholder=Enter a value]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Clearable search
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpTextfield[label=Search,value=Garden,clearable]{}
\end{document}
